from rdkit import Chem
import numpy as np, pickle

with open('embed_results.pkl','rb') as f:
    data = pickle.load(f)

def frame_coords(mol, conf):
    p = lambda i: np.array(conf.GetAtomPosition(i))
    Ca, Cc, Cb, Nb, Nt = p(0), p(8), p(9), p(7), p(19)
    e1 = Cb - Ca; e1 /= np.linalg.norm(e1)          # rightward in drawing
    up = Nt - Nb
    e2 = up - np.dot(up, e1)*e1; e2 /= np.linalg.norm(e2)   # upward in drawing
    e3 = np.cross(e1, e2)                           # toward viewer
    c = (Ca+Cb+Cc+Nb+Nt)/5
    hCa = [a.GetIdx() for a in mol.GetAtomWithIdx(0).GetNeighbors() if a.GetSymbol()=='H'][0]
    zH  = float(np.dot(p(hCa)-c, e3))
    zEt = float(np.dot(p(10)-c, e3))
    return zH, zEt

for key in [("@","@@"), ("@@","@")]:
    en, sh, set_, molblock = data[key]
    m = Chem.MolFromMolBlock(molblock)
    conf = m.GetConformer()
    zH, zEt = frame_coords(m, conf)
    print(f"ca={key[0]} cb={key[1]} : z(H toward viewer)={zH:+.2f}, z(Et toward viewer)={zEt:+.2f}")

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np

def embed_best(sm, n=40):
    m = Chem.MolFromSmiles(sm)
    m = Chem.AddHs(m)
    best=None
    for seed in range(n):
        m2 = Chem.Mol(m)
        ps = AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed = seed+7
        if AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m2, ps)!=0: continue
        AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m2, maxIters=800)
        ff = AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(m2, AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(m2))
        en = ff.CalcEnergy()
        if best is None or en<best[0]: best=(en,Chem.Mol(m2))
    return best

smA = "[C@H]1(c2ccccc2N23)C25[C@@](CC)(CCC3(=O))CCCN5C(=O)C1"
smB = "[C@@H]1(c2ccccc2N23)C25[C@](CC)(CCC3(=O))CCCN5C(=O)C1"

def frame_test(m):
    conf = m.GetConformer()
    p = lambda i: np.array(conf.GetAtomPosition(i))
    Ca,Cc,Cb,Nb,Nt = p(0),p(8),p(9),p(7),p(19)
    e1 = Cb-Ca; e1/=np.linalg.norm(e1)
    up = Nt-Nb; e2 = up-np.dot(up,e1)*e1; e2/=np.linalg.norm(e2)
    e3 = np.cross(e1,e2)
    c=(Ca+Cb+Cc+Nb+Nt)/5
    hCa=[a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtomWithIdx(0).GetNeighbors() if a.GetSymbol()=='H'][0]
    return float(np.dot(p(hCa)-c,e3)), float(np.dot(p(10)-c,e3))

for name,sm in [("A(@,@@)",smA),("B(@@,@)",smB)]:
    en,mol = embed_best(sm)
    zH,zEt = frame_test(mol)
    print(f"{name}: E={en:.2f}  zH={zH:+.2f}  zEt={zEt:+.2f}")
    Chem.MolToMolFile(mol, f"embed_{name[0]}.mol")
    mol2 = Chem.RemoveHs(mol)
    print("   CIP Ca:", Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(mol2, includeUnassigned=True))
EOF

import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem

def read_xyz(fn):
    lines=open(fn).read().splitlines(); n=int(lines[0]); s=[]; c=[]
    for ln in lines[2:2+n]:
        p=ln.split(); s.append(p[0]); c.append([float(v) for v in p[1:4]])
    return s, np.array(c)

s_ref, c_ref = read_xyz('embed_A.xyz')
s_opt, c_opt = read_xyz('optimized.xyz')
assert s_ref==s_opt, "atom order mismatch"

# neighbor lists from reference connectivity
m = Chem.MolFromMolFile('embed_A.mol', removeHs=False)
nbrs = {i: sorted(a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors()) for i in [0,8,9]}
def chirality_sign(c, center, order):
    v = [c[j]-c[center] for j in order]
    return np.sign(np.linalg.det(np.stack([v[0]-v[3], v[1]-v[3], v[2]-v[3]])))
for ctr in [0,8,9]:
    o = nbrs[ctr]
    s1 = chirality_sign(c_ref, ctr, o)
    s2 = chirality_sign(c_opt, ctr, o)
    print(f"center {ctr}: ref sign={s1:+.0f} opt sign={s2:+.0f} retained={s1==s2}")

# bond length sanity for key bonds
bonds = [(20,21,'C=O pyrrolidinone'),(14,15,'C=O lactam'),(8,7,'Cc-Nb aminal'),(8,19,'Cc-Nt aminal'),
         (0,8,'Ca-Cc'),(8,9,'Cc-Cb'),(1,2,'arom'),(19,20,'Nt-C(O) amide'),(7,14,'Nb-C(O) amide')]
for i,j,lab in bonds:
    print(f"{lab:22s} {np.linalg.norm(c_opt[i]-c_opt[j]):.3f} A")
EOF
